notes: L4 (code) = new L3 subcategory descriptions, nested under each L3 (code) = new L2 anchor.
This file does NOT replace l3_taxonomy_anchors.json — it extends it with subcategory detail.
54 of 122 subcategories carried over unchanged from the prior version; 3 were merged/rewritten (Safety & PPE, Sequencing, Zebrafish Models); the remainder (65) are net-new, mostly services.
Imaging & Microscopy equipment split into 4 discrete nodes: Confocal Microscopy, Electron Microscopy (Cryo-EM), High-Content Imaging, Spatial Imaging.

v4.0: added 71 new L4 (code-L4) subcategories under the 13 new L2 categories; replaced confocal_microscopy/electron_microscopy_cryo_em/high_content_imaging/spatial_imaging with a single imaging_microscopy node (modality is now a spec, not a taxonomy branch).

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Bottles & Containers
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Standalone laboratory bottles and general-purpose containers for storing, dispensing, and transporting liquids, powders, and bulk reagents. Includes media bottles, reagent bottles, Nalgene bottles, HDPE bottles, glass bottles, amber bottles, wash bottles, carboys, jerricans, aspirator bottles, dropping bottles, wide-mouth bottles, narrow-mouth bottles, and graduated containers. Does NOT include tubes or vials designed for sample processing or centrifugation — see Tubes & Vials. Also includes caps, closures, and other bottle/container accessories.

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Cleaning & Sterilization
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Laboratory cleaning agents, sterilization materials, and decontamination supplies for maintaining clean and sterile environments. Includes lab wipes, Kimwipes, lens tissues, germicidal wipes, bleach wipes, disinfectant wipes, alcohol wipes, isopropanol wipes, cleaning solutions, lab detergents (Alconox, Liquinox), autoclave bags, sterilization pouches, biological indicators, autoclave tape, sterilization wrap, decontamination solutions, and surface disinfectants.

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Filtration
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Filtration membranes, filter papers, filtration devices, and filtration systems for clarifying, sterilizing, and concentrating liquids and gases in laboratory settings. Includes syringe filters, membrane filters, PVDF filters, nylon filters, PES filters, PTFE filters, cellulose acetate filters, filter papers (Whatman, qualitative, quantitative, ashless), vacuum filter units, bottle-top filters, filter cups, ultrafiltration membranes, nanofiltration, filter holders, filter funnels, vacuum manifolds, and in-line filters. Does NOT include chromatography columns, resins, or other specialty separation media.

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Labeling & Tape
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Labels, tapes, and marking supplies for identifying laboratory samples, containers, and equipment. Includes laboratory tape, autoclave tape, cryogenic labels, freezer labels, cryo-labels, color-coded dots, labeling tape, tube labels, vial labels, self-adhesive labels, write-on labels, laboratory markers, Sharpie markers, cryogenic markers, label printers, and label printer cartridges.

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Laboratory Glassware
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Individual glass and borosilicate labware pieces sold as bench consumables or durable reusables. Includes beakers, Erlenmeyer flasks, round-bottom flasks, volumetric flasks, graduated cylinders, crystallizing dishes, evaporating dishes, Petri dishes (glass), watch glasses, funnels, glass tubing, glass rods, stirring rods, desiccators, separatory funnels, Büchner funnels, condensers, distillation glassware, Pyrex glassware, Kimax glassware, and borosilicate glass labware. Does NOT include plastic or disposable plasticware — see Bottles & Containers or Tubes & Vials.

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Microplates
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Multiwell plates used for high-throughput assays, cell culture, compound screening, and sample storage. Includes 6-well, 12-well, 24-well, 48-well, 96-well, 384-well, and 1536-well formats in flat-bottom, round-bottom, V-bottom, U-bottom, and half-area configurations. Encompasses tissue culture-treated (TC-treated) plates, ultra-low attachment plates, glass-bottom plates, black-walled plates, white-walled plates, clear plates, non-binding surface plates, and specialty plates for fluorescence, luminescence, and absorbance readouts. Also includes microplate lids, sealing films, adhesive plate seals, and strip-well plates. Used in ELISA, cell viability assays, cytotoxicity assays, reporter gene assays, kinetic assays, drug screening, and automated liquid handling workflows. Does NOT include microscopy slides or coverslips — see Microscopy Supplies.

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Pipettes & Tips
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Manual and electronic pipettes, multichannel pipettes, and all compatible pipette tips and accessories. Includes micropipettes, Eppendorf pipettes, Rainin pipettes, single-channel pipettes, 8-channel pipettes, 12-channel pipettes, 96-channel pipettes, electronic pipettes, repeat dispensers, serological pipettes, Pasteur pipettes, transfer pipettes, pipette tips (filtered, non-filtered, low-retention, wide-bore, gel-loading), tip boxes, tip refill stacks, pipette stands, calibration weights, and pipette controllers.

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Syringes & Needles
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Disposable and reusable syringes and hypodermic needles for laboratory fluid handling, injection, and sampling. Includes Luer-lock syringes, slip-tip syringes, glass syringes, gas-tight syringes, Hamilton syringes, dispensing syringes, hypodermic needles, blunt-tip dispensing needles, cannulas, needle hubs, and safety needles. Identified by volume (mL), gauge, needle length, and tip type. Does NOT include syringe filters — see Filtration.

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Tubes & Vials
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Disposable and reusable tubes and vials used for sample collection, processing, storage, and analysis. Includes microcentrifuge tubes, Eppendorf tubes, 1.5 mL tubes, 2.0 mL tubes, centrifuge tubes, 15 mL conical tubes, 50 mL conical tubes, PCR tubes, PCR strips, cryovials, cryogenic tubes, sample vials, HPLC vials, GC vials, autosampler vials, blood collection tubes, serum separator tubes, culture tubes, test tubes, snap-cap tubes, screw-cap tubes, and specimen collection tubes. Does NOT include bottles for bulk reagent storage — see Bottles & Containers. Also includes caps, closures, and other tube/vial accessories.

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Tubing & Hoses
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Flexible laboratory tubing, hoses, and connectors for fluid transfer, gas delivery, and peristaltic pump applications. Includes silicone tubing, Tygon tubing, Pharmed tubing, PTFE tubing, vinyl tubing, rubber tubing, peristaltic pump tubing, vacuum tubing, laboratory hoses, barbed fittings, luer connectors, stopcocks, manifolds, and tubing clamps. Identified by inner diameter, outer diameter, material, and pressure rating.

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Research Animal Diets & Husbandry Supplies
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Specialty diets, feed formulations, and husbandry consumables designed for research animals used in in vivo studies. Includes high-fat diets, high-cholesterol diets, Western diets, purified ingredient diets, irradiated diets, autoclavable diets, low-fat control diets, defined nutritional diets for metabolic research, custom diet formulations, rodent chow, rabbit pellets, zebrafish feed, and animal husbandry consumables such as bedding material, cage accessories, nesting material, and enrichment items for laboratory animals. Products identified by species compatibility (mouse, rat, rabbit, zebrafish), fat content percentage, caloric density, and nutritional composition.

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Microscopy Supplies
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Consumable and reusable optical components used in light, fluorescence, confocal, and brightfield microscopy. Includes standard glass slides, frosted slides, charged slides, poly-L-lysine coated slides, adhesion slides, and specialty slides for histology and cytology. Encompasses coverslips and cover glass in standard and high-precision thicknesses (No. 0, 1, 1.5, 2), counting chambers, hemocytometers, Neubauer chambers, and Fuchs-Rosenthal chambers. Also includes mounting media (aqueous and non-aqueous), antifade mounting media, DAPI-containing mounting media, immersion oil (Types A, B, N), glycerol, slide mailers, slide boxes, and staining jars. Does NOT include microplates with glass bottoms used primarily for plate-based assays — see Microplates.

lab_supplies_consumables.label: Safety & PPE
lab_supplies_consumables.description: Personal protective equipment (PPE), protective clothing, and bench-scale safety supplies for laboratory use. Includes nitrile gloves, latex gloves, vinyl gloves, neoprene gloves, examination gloves, cleanroom gloves, chemical-resistant gloves, cryogenic gloves, lab coats, disposable lab coats, cleanroom gowns, safety goggles, safety glasses, face shields, splash goggles, ear protection, shoe and boot covers, secondary containment trays, spill kits, acid and solvent spill kits, chemical waste containers, safety cans, hazmat and GHS labels, SDS binders, and desiccants. Identified by material, size, protection level, and hazard class. Does NOT include flammable or chemical storage cabinets — see Furniture and Storage.

molecular_biology_reagents.label: PCR & qPCR Reagents
molecular_biology_reagents.description: Reagents, master mixes, and enzymes for polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and quantitative PCR (qPCR) amplification. Includes Taq polymerase, high-fidelity polymerases (Q5, Phusion, Pfu), PCR master mixes, qPCR master mixes (SYBR Green, TaqMan), RT-qPCR one-step kits, reverse transcriptase enzymes, dNTP mixes, PCR buffers, qPCR probes, primer design reagents, digital PCR reagents, and multiplexed PCR kits. Identified by fidelity, amplicon size range, and compatibility with detection chemistry.

molecular_biology_reagents.label: Cloning & Expression
molecular_biology_reagents.description: Reagents for molecular cloning, gene expression, and recombinant protein production. Includes restriction enzymes, DNA ligases, T4 DNA ligase, Gibson Assembly reagents, Golden Gate assembly kits, ligation kits, cloning vectors, expression vectors, competent cells, transformation reagents, recombinase-based cloning systems (Gateway, TOPO), protein expression kits, in vitro transcription kits, cell-free expression systems, and plasmid preparation reagents.

molecular_biology_reagents.label: Gene Editing
molecular_biology_reagents.description: Reagents and components for site-directed genome modification using nuclease-based editing technologies. Includes CRISPR-Cas9 systems, Cas12a (Cpf1) systems, Cas9 protein, guide RNA (gRNA), single guide RNA (sgRNA), tracrRNA, crRNA, CRISPR libraries, base editor systems, prime editing reagents, TALEN construction kits, zinc finger nuclease reagents, homology-directed repair (HDR) templates, and gene editing validation reagents. Identified by target gene, cell type compatibility, and delivery format.

molecular_biology_reagents.label: RNA Interference
molecular_biology_reagents.description: RNA-based reagents for gene silencing and knockdown through the RNA interference pathway. Includes small interfering RNA (siRNA), short hairpin RNA (shRNA), microRNA (miRNA) mimics, microRNA inhibitors (antagomirs), antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs), negative control siRNA, scrambled siRNA controls, siRNA transfection reagents, RNAi libraries, and pre-designed gene-specific siRNA pools. Identified by target gene, species, and modification status (unmodified, chemically modified, 2'-OMe).

molecular_biology_reagents.label: Sequencing
molecular_biology_reagents.description: Reagents, kits, and services for DNA sequencing, library preparation, and next-generation sequencing (NGS) workflows. Includes Sanger sequencing reagents, sequencing primers, NGS library preparation kits, adapter ligation reagents, end-repair reagents, size selection beads (AMPure XP), index primers, sequencing adapters, whole genome sequencing kits, RNA-seq library preparation kits, ChIP-seq kits, ATAC-seq kits, sequencing quality control reagents, and outsourced sequencing runs. Compatible with Illumina, Oxford Nanopore, PacBio, and Ion Torrent platforms.

molecular_biology_reagents.label: Gene Synthesis
molecular_biology_reagents.description: Custom synthesis of DNA constructs, genes, and gene fragments to a specified sequence. Includes de novo gene synthesis, codon optimization, synthetic gene fragments, gBlocks, clonal genes, synthetic operons, and codon-optimized coding sequences delivered cloned into a vector or as linear DNA. Identified by target sequence length, GC content, complexity, and delivery format (vector-cloned vs. linear fragment).

molecular_biology_reagents.label: Plasmids & Vectors
molecular_biology_reagents.description: Plasmid DNA and viral vectors used to carry, express, or deliver genetic material. Includes expression plasmids, cloning vectors, shuttle vectors, reporter plasmids, CRISPR vectors, lentiviral vectors, adenoviral vectors, AAV vectors, retroviral vectors, empty backbone vectors, and plasmid preparation and purification services (miniprep, maxiprep, endotoxin-free prep). Identified by vector backbone, selection marker, promoter, insert, and packaging/delivery system.

molecular_biology_reagents.label: Oligos & Primers
molecular_biology_reagents.description: Custom-synthesized and catalog oligonucleotides for PCR, sequencing, and cloning applications. Includes DNA primers, forward and reverse primer pairs, degenerate primers, PCR primers, sequencing primers, qPCR primers, TaqMan probes, molecular beacons, LNA-modified oligos, biotinylated oligos, fluorescently labeled oligos, ultramers, and long single-stranded DNA oligos. Identified by target sequence, length, modification (5' or 3' labels, internal modifications), purification grade (desalted, HPLC, PAGE), and scale of synthesis.

chemicals_solvents.label: Alcohols
chemicals_solvents.description: Alcohol-class organic compounds used as solvents, reagents, and chemical intermediates in laboratory and industrial applications. Includes methanol, ethanol, isopropanol (IPA), n-propanol, n-butanol, isobutanol, tert-butanol, benzyl alcohol, ethylene glycol, glycerol, phenol, cyclohexanol, furfuryl alcohol, and other mono- and polyhydric alcohols. Identified by CAS number, purity grade (ACS, HPLC, anhydrous, denatured), and physical form.

chemicals_solvents.label: Organic Acids
chemicals_solvents.description: Carboxylic acids, amino acids (as bulk chemicals), and other organic acid compounds used as reagents, buffers, and chemical intermediates. Includes acetic acid, formic acid, citric acid, tartaric acid, oxalic acid, lactic acid, succinic acid, maleic acid, fumaric acid, benzoic acid, trifluoroacetic acid (TFA), EDTA, trichloroacetic acid, and other organic acid compounds. Does NOT include amino acids sold as biological standards or peptide components — see Peptides & Amino Acids under Proteins and Peptides.

chemicals_solvents.label: Polyols
chemicals_solvents.description: Multi-hydroxyl compounds including sugar alcohols, diols, and triols used as chemical intermediates, humectants, and reagents. Includes ethylene glycol, propylene glycol, glycerol (glycerin), sorbitol, mannitol, xylitol, erythritol, pentaerythritol, polyethylene glycol (PEG) polymers, polypropylene glycol, and other polyhydric alcohol compounds.

chemicals_solvents.label: Sodium Salts
chemicals_solvents.description: Sodium-containing inorganic and organic salt compounds used as reagents, buffers, and chemical raw materials. Includes sodium chloride, sodium hydroxide, sodium bicarbonate, sodium carbonate, sodium sulfate, sodium phosphate, sodium acetate, sodium nitrate, sodium nitrite, sodium citrate, sodium EDTA, sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS), sodium azide, sodium borohydride, and other sodium salt compounds. Identified by CAS number, purity, and hydration state.

chemicals_solvents.label: Esters
chemicals_solvents.description: Ester-class organic compounds used as solvents, plasticizers, fragrances, and chemical intermediates. Includes ethyl acetate, methyl acetate, butyl acetate, isopropyl acetate, ethyl formate, dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO), diethyl phthalate, tributyl phosphate, methyl benzoate, and other ester compounds. Identified by CAS number, purity grade, and solvent application.

chemicals_solvents.label: Coatings, Sealants & Adhesives
chemicals_solvents.description: Chemical coating materials, sealants, and adhesive compounds for laboratory and industrial applications. Includes epoxy coatings, protective coatings, anti-corrosion coatings, silicone sealants, RTV sealants, O-ring compounds, thread sealants, adhesive compounds, cyanoacrylate adhesives, UV-curable adhesives, and specialty coating chemicals.

chemicals_solvents.label: Resins & Modifiers
chemicals_solvents.description: Polymeric resins, resin modifiers, curing agents, and reactive chemical modifiers used in synthesis, formulation, and industrial chemistry. Includes epoxy resins, phenolic resins, polyester resins, acrylic resins, ion exchange resins, resin modifiers, cross-linking agents, curing agents, hardeners, accelerators, and chemical process modifiers and intermediates.

chemicals_solvents.label: Inorganic Compounds & Salts
chemicals_solvents.description: Inorganic chemical compounds, mineral salts, metal salts, and inorganic reagents used in laboratory and industrial chemistry. Includes calcium chloride, magnesium chloride, potassium chloride, ammonium sulfate, copper sulfate, zinc sulfate, iron salts, manganese salts, lithium salts, barium salts, phosphoric acid, hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid, nitric acid, ammonia, hydrogen peroxide, and other inorganic reagents not classified as sodium salts. Identified by CAS number, purity, and physical form.

chemicals_solvents.label: Bioactive Small Molecules
chemicals_solvents.description: Small-molecule compounds with defined biological activity used as research tools, inhibitors, agonists, or probes. Includes kinase inhibitors, enzyme inhibitors, receptor agonists and antagonists, natural product compounds, screening hit compounds, tool compounds, and pathway modulators. Identified by target, mechanism of action, potency (IC50/EC50), and purity.

chemicals_solvents.label: Building Blocks & Screening Libraries
chemicals_solvents.description: Chemical building blocks and pre-assembled compound collections used for synthesis and drug discovery screening. Includes synthetic intermediates, fragment libraries, diversity libraries, focused screening libraries, natural product libraries, and combinatorial chemistry building blocks. Identified by scaffold class, molecular weight range, functional groups, and library size.

chemicals_solvents.label: Solvents
chemicals_solvents.description: Organic and inorganic solvents used for extraction, dissolution, and reaction chemistry. Includes HPLC-grade solvents, ACS-grade solvents, anhydrous solvents, deuterated solvents (NMR solvents), aprotic solvents, protic solvents, and bulk industrial solvents. Identified by purity grade, water content, and CAS number.

chemicals_solvents.label: Buffers & pH Reagents
chemicals_solvents.description: Buffering agents, pH standards, and pH-adjustment reagents used across laboratory workflows. Includes phosphate buffers, Tris buffers, HEPES, MOPS, citrate buffers, pH calibration standards, pH indicator solutions, acids and bases used for pH adjustment, and pre-made buffer concentrates. Identified by buffering range, molarity, and pH.

chemicals_solvents.label: Custom / med-chem synthesis
chemicals_solvents.description: Custom chemical synthesis services, including medicinal chemistry support for drug discovery programs. Includes custom compound synthesis, scale-up synthesis, analog synthesis, SAR (structure-activity relationship) compound sets, route scouting, and process chemistry support delivered on a project or contract basis. Identified by target molecule, scale, and required purity.

chemicals_solvents.label: Analytical chemistry
chemicals_solvents.description: Contracted analytical testing services for characterizing and quantifying chemical substances. Includes purity analysis, identity confirmation, impurity profiling, elemental analysis, residual solvent testing, stability testing, and method development and validation performed by an outside lab on submitted samples.

chemicals_solvents.label: Chromatography & purification
chemicals_solvents.description: Chromatography-based purification and separation services for chemical and biological samples. Includes preparative HPLC, flash chromatography, ion-exchange purification, size-exclusion purification, and custom purification of synthesized compounds or reaction mixtures performed as a service.

chemicals_solvents.label: Radiochemistry
chemicals_solvents.description: Radiolabeled compounds and radiochemistry services for tracer and imaging applications. Includes custom radiolabeling, tritium (3H) and carbon-14 (14C) labeled compounds, radioisotope handling services, and specific-activity characterization. Identified by isotope, labeling position, and specific activity.

chemicals_solvents.label: Physical / structural analysis
chemicals_solvents.description: Services and testing for determining the physical and structural properties of chemical substances. Includes X-ray crystallography, NMR structure elucidation, mass spectrometry structure confirmation, particle size analysis, thermal analysis (DSC, TGA), and polymorph screening performed on submitted samples.

antibodies.label: Primary Antibodies
antibodies.description: Antibodies that bind directly to the target antigen of interest, used as the first layer of detection in immunoassays and imaging experiments. Includes unconjugated primary antibodies identified by target protein or epitope (p53, GAPDH, beta-actin, Ki-67, CD3, CD4, CD8, PD-L1, HER2, EGFR, vimentin, E-cadherin), host species (rabbit, mouse, rat, goat), clonality (monoclonal, polyclonal, recombinant), and validated application (WB, IHC, ICC, IF, flow cytometry, ELISA, ChIP, IP). Does NOT include antibodies pre-conjugated to fluorophores or enzymes — see Conjugated Antibodies.

antibodies.label: Secondary Antibodies
antibodies.description: Antibodies raised against immunoglobulins of another species, used to detect primary antibodies in indirect detection systems. Includes anti-mouse IgG, anti-rabbit IgG, anti-goat IgG, anti-rat IgG, anti-human IgG, anti-chicken IgY, and secondary antibodies against IgM, IgA, and IgE isotypes. Identified by target species, host species (donkey, goat, sheep), conjugate (HRP, AP, biotin, FITC, Alexa Fluor, PE), and cross-adsorption status. Does NOT include primary antibodies — see Primary Antibodies.

antibodies.label: Conjugated Antibodies
antibodies.description: Primary antibodies directly conjugated to fluorescent dyes, enzymes, or other detection moieties for single-step detection without a secondary antibody. Includes antibodies conjugated to FITC, PE, APC, BV421, Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 647, PE-Cy7, PerCP, HRP, alkaline phosphatase, biotin, gold nanoparticles, and other direct labels. Commonly used in flow cytometry panels, multiplexed IHC, ELISA, and lateral flow assays.

antibodies.label: Isotype Controls
antibodies.description: Control antibodies matched to the isotype, host species, and conjugate of an experimental antibody but lacking specific antigen reactivity, used to measure non-specific background binding. Includes mouse IgG1, IgG2a, IgG2b, IgG3 isotype controls, rabbit IgG controls, rat IgG controls, goat IgG controls, and isotype controls in unconjugated and conjugated formats (FITC, PE, APC, HRP, biotin). Identified by isotype class, subclass, host species, and conjugate.

antibodies.label: Antibody Fragments
antibodies.description: Engineered antibody-derived binding molecules smaller than full-length immunoglobulins, used for applications requiring smaller size, better tissue penetration, or reduced Fc-mediated effects. Includes Fab fragments, F(ab')2 fragments, single-chain variable fragments (scFv), nanobodies (VHH), single-domain antibodies, bispecific antibody fragments, diabodies, and other antibody-derived binding proteins. Also includes IgG blocking reagents such as Fc receptor blocking agents.

antibodies.label: Antibody validation
antibodies.description: Services for characterizing and validating antibody specificity and performance. Includes knockout/knockdown validation, orthogonal application validation, cross-reactivity testing, lot-to-lot consistency testing, and application-specific validation (western blot, IHC, flow cytometry, ELISA) performed on a submitted or custom-produced antibody.

proteins_peptides.label: Recombinant Proteins
proteins_peptides.description: Proteins produced through recombinant DNA technology in heterologous expression systems for research and assay development. Includes recombinant human proteins, recombinant mouse proteins, recombinant viral proteins, recombinant bacterial proteins, fusion proteins, tag-purified proteins (His-tag, GST-tag, Fc-fusion), and proteins expressed in E. coli, HEK293, CHO, baculovirus, yeast, or wheat germ systems. Identified by gene name, species, expression system, purity, and biological activity (ED50). Does NOT include antibodies — see Antibodies. Does NOT include cytokines or growth factors — see Cytokines & Growth Factors.

proteins_peptides.label: Cytokines & Growth Factors
proteins_peptides.description: Signaling proteins that regulate cell growth, differentiation, immune response, and tissue homeostasis. Includes interleukins (IL-1 through IL-40), interferons (IFN-alpha, IFN-beta, IFN-gamma), tumor necrosis factors (TNF-alpha, TNF-beta), chemokines (CXCL, CCL family), colony-stimulating factors (G-CSF, M-CSF, GM-CSF), epidermal growth factor (EGF), fibroblast growth factors (FGF-1, FGF-2), VEGF, TGF-beta, PDGF, insulin-like growth factors (IGF-1, IGF-2), bone morphogenetic proteins (BMP), and neurotrophins (NGF, BDNF, NT-3).

proteins_peptides.label: Enzymes
proteins_peptides.description: Purified non-antibody enzyme proteins for biochemical assays, substrate processing, and research applications. Includes proteases (trypsin, chymotrypsin, pepsin, elastase, collagenase, dispase, papain), nucleases (DNase I, RNase A), kinases, phosphatases, peroxidases (HRP), luciferases, beta-galactosidase, alkaline phosphatase, glucose oxidase, superoxide dismutase, catalase, lysozyme, and other purified enzyme proteins. Does NOT include molecular biology enzymes such as polymerases or restriction enzymes — see Molecular Biology & Genomics.

proteins_peptides.label: Peptides & Amino Acids
proteins_peptides.description: Short amino acid chains and individual amino acid compounds for biochemical research, assay development, and cell culture supplementation. Includes custom synthesized peptides, peptide libraries, FMOC-protected amino acids, fluorescent peptide substrates, cell-penetrating peptides, antimicrobial peptides, peptide hormones, L-amino acids, D-amino acids, non-natural amino acids, amino acid standards, and dipeptides and tripeptides. Identified by sequence, length, purity, and modification status. Also tagged by production grade (research-use or GMP).

proteins_peptides.label: Albumin & Carrier Proteins
proteins_peptides.description: Abundant structural and transport proteins used as blocking agents, stabilizers, carriers, and diluents in immunoassays and cell culture. Includes bovine serum albumin (BSA), human serum albumin (HSA), ovalbumin, casein, gelatin, fibronectin, vitronectin, transferrin, lactoferrin, keyhole limpet hemocyanin (KLH), thyroglobulin, collagen, fibrinogen, and other carrier or blocking proteins. Commonly used in ELISA blocking, western blot blocking, antibody stabilization, and protein standard preparation.

proteins_peptides.label: Protein purification
proteins_peptides.description: Services for isolating and purifying proteins from expression systems or crude preparations. Includes affinity purification, ion-exchange purification, size-exclusion purification, tag removal, endotoxin removal, and polishing steps delivered as a contract service. Identified by target protein, expression source, and required purity level.

proteins_peptides.label: Protein characterization
proteins_peptides.description: Analytical services for confirming protein identity, purity, and structure. Includes mass spectrometry-based identity confirmation, SDS-PAGE and Western blot analysis, size-exclusion chromatography (SEC) purity analysis, circular dichroism, thermal stability (DSF) analysis, and aggregation analysis performed on a submitted protein sample.

proteins_peptides.label: Protein engineering
proteins_peptides.description: Services for modifying or optimizing protein sequence, stability, or function. Includes directed evolution, rational design, affinity maturation, stability engineering, fusion protein design, and codon optimization for expression, delivered as a custom project.

proteins_peptides.label: Protein conjugation & labeling
proteins_peptides.description: Services for chemically conjugating proteins to labels, tags, or other molecules. Includes fluorophore conjugation, biotin conjugation, enzyme conjugation (HRP, AP), PEGylation, and custom bioconjugation performed on a submitted or custom-produced protein.

kits_assays.label: ELISA Kits
kits_assays.description: Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay kits for quantifying proteins, hormones, cytokines, and other analytes in biological samples. Includes sandwich ELISA kits, competitive ELISA kits, direct ELISA kits, ELISA development kits, TMB substrate kits, ELISA coating antibody and detection antibody pairs, and multiplex ELISA kits. Identified by target analyte (IL-6, TNF-alpha, insulin, cortisol, IgG), sample matrix compatibility (serum, plasma, cell culture supernatant), and sensitivity range.

kits_assays.label: Cell-Based Assays
kits_assays.description: Kits and reagent systems for measuring cellular processes, viability, proliferation, apoptosis, signaling, and function in living cells. Includes cell viability assays (MTT, MTS, WST-1, CellTiter-Glo, resazurin), apoptosis assay kits (Annexin V, TUNEL, caspase activity), proliferation assay kits (BrdU, EdU, Ki-67), cell migration assays, invasion assays, reporter gene assays (luciferase, beta-galactosidase), oxidative stress assay kits, and calcium flux assay kits.

kits_assays.label: Nucleic Acid Extraction Kits
kits_assays.description: Pre-packaged kits for extracting, purifying, and isolating DNA, RNA, and other nucleic acids from biological samples. Includes genomic DNA extraction kits, plasmid DNA miniprep and midiprep kits, RNA extraction kits, total RNA isolation kits, mRNA purification kits, small RNA isolation kits, cfDNA extraction kits, FFPE nucleic acid extraction kits, viral RNA extraction kits, and column-based, magnetic bead-based, and liquid-phase nucleic acid purification systems.

kits_assays.label: Protein Quantification Kits
kits_assays.description: Kits for measuring protein concentration and purity in laboratory samples using colorimetric, fluorometric, or absorbance-based methods. Includes BCA protein assay kits, Bradford assay kits (Coomassie), Lowry protein assay kits, DC protein assay kits, fluorometric protein quantification kits, nanodrop-compatible assay reagents, reducing agent-compatible assay kits, and detergent-compatible protein assay reagents. Includes BSA protein standards and albumin standard curves.

kits_assays.label: Detection & Imaging Kits
kits_assays.description: Kits for detecting, staining, and imaging biological targets in cells, tissues, and membranes using fluorescence, chemiluminescence, or chromogenic methods. Includes western blot detection kits, chemiluminescent HRP substrate kits (ECL), fluorescent western blot kits, immunohistochemistry (IHC) detection kits, immunofluorescence staining kits, cell staining kits, nuclear stains (DAPI, Hoechst), live/dead staining kits, membrane staining kits, immunoprecipitation (IP) kits, and co-immunoprecipitation (co-IP) kits.

kits_assays.label: Flow Cytometry Assays
kits_assays.description: Pre-packaged assay kits designed for flow cytometry-based analysis. Includes apoptosis detection kits, cell cycle analysis kits, immunophenotyping panels, viability dye kits, cell proliferation kits, and multiplexed bead-based flow assays. Identified by target marker(s), fluorophore panel, and compatible instrument platform.

kits_assays.label: Custom assay development & validation
kits_assays.description: Services for designing, developing, and validating a laboratory assay to a customer's specifications. Includes feasibility studies, assay optimization, analytical validation (sensitivity, specificity, precision), and transfer of a validated assay protocol, delivered as a contract project.

kits_assays.label: High-throughput screening (HTS)
kits_assays.description: Screening services for testing large compound or reagent libraries against a biological target at scale. Includes primary HTS campaigns, secondary/confirmatory screening, dose-response screening, and hit validation performed using automated liquid handling and plate-based readouts, delivered as a contract service.

cell_tissue_culture.label: Culture Media
cell_tissue_culture.description: Liquid and powder culture media formulations for maintaining, growing, and differentiating mammalian and non-mammalian cells in vitro. Includes DMEM, RPMI-1640, MEM, IMDM, F-12 (Ham's), McCoy's 5A, DMEM/F-12, alpha-MEM, William's Medium E, MCDB media, serum-free media, defined media, chemically defined media, StemPro media, mTeSR, Essential 8, and specialty media for specific cell types (endothelial, epithelial, neuronal, stem cells). Does NOT include agar or microbial growth media.

cell_tissue_culture.label: Sera & Supplements
cell_tissue_culture.description: Animal sera and defined supplements added to culture media to support cell growth and function. Includes fetal bovine serum (FBS), fetal calf serum (FCS), horse serum, human serum, newborn calf serum, donor equine serum, B-27 supplement, N-2 supplement, GlutaMAX, L-glutamine, non-essential amino acids (NEAA), sodium pyruvate, HEPES buffer, insulin-transferrin-selenium (ITS), growth factor supplements, antibiotic-antimycotic solutions (penicillin-streptomycin, gentamicin), and mycoplasma prevention reagents.

cell_tissue_culture.label: Matrices & Coatings
cell_tissue_culture.description: Extracellular matrix proteins, basement membrane preparations, and surface coatings applied to cell culture vessels to promote cell attachment, growth, and differentiation. Includes Matrigel, growth factor reduced Matrigel, collagen I, collagen IV, fibronectin, laminin, vitronectin, gelatin, poly-L-lysine, poly-D-lysine, poly-L-ornithine, ultra-low attachment coatings, and basement membrane extract (BME). Applied to culture flasks, plates, slides, and wells before seeding cells.

cell_tissue_culture.label: Cryopreservation
cell_tissue_culture.description: Reagents and media for freezing and long-term cryogenic storage of living cells while maintaining viability. Includes DMSO (cell culture grade), freezing media, CryoStor, Mr. Frosty freezing containers, controlled-rate freezing media, serum-free cryopreservation media, cell banker, bambanker, Recovery Cell Culture Freezing Medium, and complete cryopreservation solutions for cell lines, primary cells, stem cells, and organoids. Does NOT include general laboratory DMSO as a chemical — see Chemicals and Solvents.

cell_tissue_culture.label: Dissociation Reagents
cell_tissue_culture.description: Enzymatic and non-enzymatic reagents for detaching adherent cells from culture surfaces and dissociating tissue into single-cell suspensions. Includes trypsin, trypsin-EDTA, trypsin-like enzymes (TrypLE, TrypZean), Accutase, Accumax, collagenase (Type I, II, IV), dispase, hyaluronidase, papain, EDTA solutions, cell dissociation buffer, non-enzymatic cell detachment solutions, and tissue dissociation kits for organ-specific protocols.

cell_tissue_culture.label: Cell Lines
cell_tissue_culture.description: A population of cells that was grown from an originator cell, and can continue to be grown and replicated indefinitely. There are many different types, but often are derived from tissues of some clinical significance (such as cancer cells for studying the effects of drugs on that cell type), but they can also represent different kinds of normal cells that you may need to leverage for a variety of lab purposes (like cells used to grow viral particles or serve as controls), animal cell lines, human primary cells (not an immortalized line but primarily derived from tissues), organoids (a specialized type of cell), and cell models.

cell_tissue_culture.label: Primary Cells
cell_tissue_culture.description: Cells isolated directly from living tissue and cultured without immortalization. Includes primary human and animal fibroblasts, hepatocytes, neurons, epithelial cells, endothelial cells, keratinocytes, and other tissue-derived primary cell types supplied for in vitro culture. Identified by tissue source, species, and donor characteristics.

cell_tissue_culture.label: Stem Cells / iPSCs
cell_tissue_culture.description: Stem cells and induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) supplied for research culture. Includes embryonic stem cells, adult/tissue stem cells, mesenchymal stem cells, hematopoietic stem cells, iPSC lines, and iPSC-derived differentiated cell types. Identified by cell type, source, pluripotency status, and genetic background.

cell_tissue_culture.label: Organoid generation
cell_tissue_culture.description: Services for generating three-dimensional organoid cultures from stem cells or primary tissue. Includes intestinal, liver, brain, tumor, and other organ-specific organoid generation, organoid expansion, and organoid characterization performed as a contract service.

cell_tissue_culture.label: Custom cell culture
cell_tissue_culture.description: Contract cell culture services performed to a customer's specifications. Includes custom cell expansion, scale-up culture, cell line adaptation, media optimization, and maintenance of customer-supplied cell lines under contract.

animal_biospecimens.label: Animal Tissue
animal_biospecimens.description: Solid tissue samples collected from animal sources for research use. Includes fresh tissue, frozen tissue, FFPE (formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded) tissue blocks and sections, and tissue microarrays from mouse, rat, non-human primate, and other species. Identified by species, tissue/organ type, disease or health status, and preservation method.

animal_biospecimens.label: Animal Blood & Biofluids
animal_biospecimens.description: Blood-derived and other liquid biological samples collected from animal sources. Includes whole blood, plasma, serum, cerebrospinal fluid, synovial fluid, and other biofluids from mouse, rat, non-human primate, and other species. Identified by species, collection method, anticoagulant type, and disease or health status.

animal_biospecimens.label: Animal Cells & PBMCs
animal_biospecimens.description: Cells and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) isolated from animal sources for research use. Includes animal PBMCs, splenocytes, bone marrow cells, and other isolated immune or tissue cells. Identified by species, tissue source, and isolation method.

animal_biospecimens.label: Animal Custom / prospective collection
animal_biospecimens.description: Prospective, custom-designed collection of animal biospecimens to a customer's specification. Includes custom collection protocols, specified timepoints, specified anticoagulants or preservation methods, and coordination with animal sourcing for a defined study, delivered as a service.

animal_biospecimens.label: Animal Biobanking & storage
animal_biospecimens.description: Long-term storage and biobanking services for animal-derived biospecimens. Includes cryogenic storage, sample tracking and inventory management, chain-of-custody documentation, and biorepository access for stored animal tissue, blood, and cell samples.

animal_biospecimens.label: Animal Sample processing (histology / FFPE / dissociation)
animal_biospecimens.description: Processing services for preparing animal tissue and biospecimens for downstream analysis. Includes histology sectioning, FFPE embedding and sectioning, tissue dissociation into single-cell suspensions, slide preparation, and staining performed on customer-supplied animal specimens.

animal_biospecimens.label: Animal Primary Cells
animal_biospecimens.description: Primary cells isolated directly from animal tissue and supplied without immortalization. Includes primary hepatocytes, fibroblasts, neurons, and other tissue-derived primary cells from mouse, rat, and other species. Identified by species, tissue source, and isolation method.

animal_biospecimens.label: Animal Stem Cells / iPSCs
animal_biospecimens.description: Stem cells and induced pluripotent stem cells derived from animal sources. Includes animal embryonic stem cells, animal iPSC lines, and animal iPSC-derived differentiated cell types. Identified by species, cell type, and genetic background.

human_biospecimens.label: Human Tissue
human_biospecimens.description: Solid tissue samples collected from human sources for research use. Includes fresh tissue, frozen tissue, FFPE (formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded) tissue blocks and sections, and tissue microarrays. Identified by tissue/organ type, disease or health status, consent status, and preservation method.

human_biospecimens.label: Human Cells & PBMCs
human_biospecimens.description: Cells and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) isolated from human donors for research use. Includes human PBMCs, leukapheresis products, and other isolated immune or tissue cells. Identified by donor characteristics, tissue source, isolation method, and consent status.

human_biospecimens.label: Human Custom / prospective collection
human_biospecimens.description: Prospective, custom-designed collection of human biospecimens to a customer's specification. Includes custom collection protocols, specified timepoints, IRB-approved collection under informed consent, and coordination with clinical sites for a defined study, delivered as a service.

human_biospecimens.label: Human Biobanking & storage
human_biospecimens.description: Long-term storage and biobanking services for human-derived biospecimens. Includes cryogenic storage, sample tracking and inventory management, chain-of-custody documentation, consent management, and biorepository access for stored human tissue, blood, and cell samples.

human_biospecimens.label: Sample processing (histology / FFPE / dissociation)
human_biospecimens.description: Processing services for preparing human tissue and biospecimens for downstream analysis. Includes histology sectioning, FFPE embedding and sectioning, tissue dissociation into single-cell suspensions, slide preparation, and staining performed on customer-supplied human specimens.

human_biospecimens.label: Human Primary Cells
human_biospecimens.description: Primary cells isolated directly from human tissue and supplied without immortalization. Includes primary human hepatocytes, fibroblasts, neurons, epithelial cells, and other tissue-derived primary cells. Identified by tissue source, donor characteristics, and isolation method.

human_biospecimens.label: Human Stem Cells / iPSCs
human_biospecimens.description: Stem cells and induced pluripotent stem cells derived from human donors. Includes human embryonic stem cells, human iPSC lines, and human iPSC-derived differentiated cell types. Identified by cell type, donor background, pluripotency status, and consent status.

human_biospecimens.label: Human Blood & Biofluids
human_biospecimens.description: Human blood-derived and other liquid biological samples supplied for research use. Includes whole blood, plasma, serum, buffy coat, cerebrospinal fluid, synovial fluid, saliva, urine, and other human biofluids. Identified by collection method, anticoagulant type (EDTA, heparin, citrate), donor disease state or health status, and any associated consent, annotation, or matched-set documentation.

animal_models.label: Rodent Models
animal_models.description: Live mice, rats, and other rodent species procured, bred, or generated for use in preclinical in vivo research, along with associated animal model services provided by CROs and vivarium suppliers. Includes inbred strains (C57BL/6, BALB/c, DBA/2, FVB/N, 129S), outbred stocks (CD-1, Sprague-Dawley, Wistar, Long-Evans), immunodeficient models (nude, SCID, NOD-SCID, NSG, Rag1/Rag2 knockout), humanized mice, germ-free and gnotobiotic mice, aged rodents, and timed-pregnant females. Encompasses genetically engineered mouse and rat models (GEMMs) including transgenic, constitutive knockout, conditional knockout (floxed/Cre), knock-in, and reporter models. Covers disease-specific models including oncology xenograft and syngeneic tumor models, metabolic disease models (db/db, ob/ob, diet-induced obesity), cardiovascular models, neuroscience models (5xFAD, APP/PS1, 3xTg-AD, SOD1), autoimmune and inflammatory models, and spontaneously hypertensive rats (SHR). Also includes services such as custom model generation (CRISPR knockouts, transgenics), colony establishment and maintenance, breeding and expansion, health monitoring, rederivation, cryopreservation of embryos and sperm, strain importation and quarantine, and genotyping services.

animal_models.label: Non-Human Primate Models
animal_models.description: Non-human primate species used for translational biomedical research closest to human physiology. Includes cynomolgus macaque (Macaca fascicularis), rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta), common marmoset (Callithrix jacchus), African green monkey, and baboon models. Used for vaccine development, infectious disease research, neuroscience, reproductive biology, and safety pharmacology studies requiring primate-specific biology.

animal_models.label: Invertebrate & Lower Organism Models
animal_models.description: Non-vertebrate and lower eukaryotic model organisms used for foundational genetics, cell biology, and aging research. Includes Drosophila melanogaster (fruit fly) strains, Caenorhabditis elegans (nematode) strains, Xenopus laevis and Xenopus tropicalis (African clawed frog), Saccharomyces cerevisiae (yeast) strains for in vivo studies, Dictyostelium discoideum, and other invertebrate model organisms. Products identified by genotype, mutant allele, reporter construct, and stock center source (Bloomington, CGC, DSSC).

animal_models.label: Other Mammalian Models
animal_models.description: Live non-rodent mammalian species procured, bred, or supplied for use in preclinical and translational in vivo research, along with associated animal model services provided by CROs and licensed research facilities. Includes rabbits (New Zealand White, Dutch Belted), guinea pigs (Hartley, Dunkin-Hartley), hamsters (Syrian, Chinese), ferrets, swine and minipigs (Göttingen minipig, Yucatan minipig, Sinclair minipig, domestic pig), dogs (Beagle), non-human primates (cynomolgus macaque, rhesus macaque, marmoset, baboon), sheep, goats, and cattle. Encompasses both purpose-bred research animals and naturally occurring or induced disease models, including cardiovascular models (swine, dog), dermatology and wound healing models (pig, rabbit), ophthalmology models (rabbit, NHP), reproductive biology models (sheep, NHP), infectious disease models (ferret influenza model, NHP SIV/SHIV models), and neuroscience and behavioral models (NHP). Also includes genetically engineered large animal models, humanized pig models, and cloned or gene-edited livestock.

animal_models.label: Zebrafish Models
animal_models.description: Zebrafish (Danio rerio) research models for developmental biology, toxicology, and genetic studies. Includes wild-type strains (AB, TU, TL), transgenic and reporter lines, mutant lines, knockout and knock-in lines, CRISPR-modified lines, embryos, larvae, and adult fish. Identified by strain, genetic modification status, developmental stage, and disease or reporter phenotype.

animal_models.label: Colony & breeding management
animal_models.description: Services for managing live animal breeding colonies on behalf of a customer. Includes colony maintenance, breeding pair management, genotyping and colony record-keeping, husbandry, and colony expansion or rederivation, delivered as an ongoing or project-based service.

animal_models.label: In vivo pharmacology / efficacy
animal_models.description: Contract in vivo studies evaluating drug efficacy, pharmacology, or disease modulation in animal models. Includes efficacy studies, dose-response studies, PK/PD studies, disease model studies (oncology, immunology, metabolic), and study design and reporting, delivered as a contract research service.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Mass Spec & Chromatography
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Analytical instrumentation for mass spectrometry and chromatographic separation. Includes mass spectrometers (LC-MS, GC-MS, MALDI-TOF, triple quadrupole), HPLC systems, UHPLC systems, GC systems, ion chromatography systems, and associated columns and detectors.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Sequencing & Genomics Platforms
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Instrumentation for DNA/RNA sequencing and genomic analysis. Includes next-generation sequencers, Sanger sequencers, real-time PCR/qPCR systems, digital PCR systems, and genotyping and microarray platforms.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Flow Cytometry & Cell Analysis
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Instrumentation for cell-based analysis and sorting. Includes flow cytometers, cell sorters, cell counters, cell viability analyzers, and imaging cytometers.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Imaging & Microscopy
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Instrumentation and platforms for visualizing cells, tissues, and molecular targets at high resolution. Includes confocal microscopy, electron microscopy (cryo-EM), high-content imaging systems, and spatial imaging/spatial omics platforms. Identified by imaging modality (confocal, electron/cryo-EM, high-content, spatial).

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Liquid Handling & Automation
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Automated systems for liquid dispensing and laboratory workflow automation. Includes automated liquid handlers, robotic pipetting systems, plate handlers, automated workstations, and laboratory automation robots.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Bioprocess & Single-Use
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Equipment and single-use systems for bioprocessing and bioproduction workflows. Includes bioreactors, single-use bioreactor bags, bioprocess control systems, tangential flow filtration (TFF) systems, and single-use tubing assemblies.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: General Lab Equipment
equipment_instruments_parts.description: General-purpose laboratory instruments used across bench workflows. Includes centrifuges, microcentrifuges, analytical balances, incubators, shakers, vortexers, homogenizers, sonicators, water baths, heating blocks, magnetic stirrers, autoclaves, and biosafety cabinets, not otherwise classified into a more specific equipment function group.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Parts & Spares
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Replacement parts and spare components for laboratory instruments. Includes lamps, seals, tubing, filters, rotors, gaskets, sensors, and other manufacturer-specific replacement parts identified by instrument make and model. Also tagged by vendor, condition (new or refurbished), and instrument throughput tier.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Instrument Consumables
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Consumable items designed for use with a specific instrument platform. Includes chromatography columns, cuvettes, capillaries, injector needles, and other instrument-specific consumables that are periodically replaced during normal operation.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Installation & Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ)
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Services for installing and formally qualifying laboratory instruments. Includes installation qualification (IQ), operational qualification (OQ), performance qualification (PQ), and associated documentation required for regulated or GxP laboratory environments.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Preventive Maintenance
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Scheduled maintenance services performed to keep laboratory instruments operating within specification. Includes routine inspection, cleaning, parts replacement, and performance verification performed on a recurring schedule, often bundled with a service contract.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Repair
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Unscheduled repair services for laboratory instruments. Includes diagnostic troubleshooting, parts replacement, and restoration of instrument function following a breakdown or performance failure.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Service Contracts
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Recurring service agreements covering ongoing instrument support. Includes full-service contracts, preventive-maintenance-only contracts, extended warranties, and time-and-materials service agreements covering a defined instrument or fleet.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Relocation
equipment_instruments_parts.description: Services for the physical relocation, decommissioning, or reinstallation of laboratory instruments. Includes instrument disconnection, packing, transport coordination, reinstallation, and requalification at a new site.

equipment_instruments_parts.label: Calibration
equipment_instruments_parts.description: On-site and depot calibration services for laboratory instruments to verify and restore measurement accuracy against traceable reference standards. Includes routine calibration, multi-point calibration, NIST-traceable calibration, balance calibration, pipette calibration, thermometer and temperature-mapping calibration, and calibration certificate issuance. Typically scheduled on a recurring basis (annual, semi-annual) as part of a lab's quality and compliance program, and often bundled with preventive maintenance visits.

analytical_reference_standards.label: Analytical Standards
analytical_reference_standards.description: Certified analytical reference compounds used to identify and quantify substances in a sample. Includes chemical reference standards, pharmaceutical reference standards, pesticide standards, and impurity/degradant reference standards. Identified by analyte, purity, and certification/traceability status.

analytical_reference_standards.label: Reference Materials & CRMs
analytical_reference_standards.description: Certified reference materials (CRMs) and standard reference materials used to validate measurement accuracy. Includes matrix-matched CRMs, elemental standards, isotope reference materials, and NIST-traceable reference materials. Identified by analyte or parameter, matrix, and certifying body.

analytical_reference_standards.label: Quality Controls
analytical_reference_standards.description: Quality control materials used to monitor assay and instrument performance over time. Includes positive controls, negative controls, assay-specific QC panels, and multi-level QC materials. Identified by analyte, matrix, and target concentration range.

analytical_reference_standards.label: Proficiency Testing
analytical_reference_standards.description: Proficiency testing (PT) materials and programs used to externally validate laboratory testing performance. Includes PT sample panels, inter-laboratory comparison programs, and proficiency testing reports used to demonstrate ongoing testing competency.

furniture_storage.label: Laboratory Furniture
furniture_storage.description: Fixed and freestanding laboratory furniture and work surface solutions for research environments. Includes laboratory benches, lab tables, adjustable-height workbenches, island benches, peninsula benches, wall-mounted benches, casework, laboratory casework systems, chemical-resistant work surfaces, epoxy resin tops, phenolic tops, and modular laboratory furniture components.

furniture_storage.label: Lab Seating
furniture_storage.description: Chairs, stools, and seating solutions designed for laboratory environments. Includes laboratory chairs, lab stools, ergonomic lab chairs, height-adjustable stools, ESD-safe chairs, cleanroom chairs, anti-static seating, saddle stools, backless stools, and seating with chemical-resistant upholstery.

furniture_storage.label: Storage and Organization
furniture_storage.description: Organizational storage systems and shelving units for laboratory supplies, chemicals, and equipment. Includes shelving units, wire shelving, laboratory shelves, wall-mounted shelving, storage racks, chemical storage racks, reagent bottle racks, tube racks, pipette holders, instrument stands, pegboards, drawer units, and modular storage systems for laboratory organization.

furniture_storage.label: Lab Storage Solutions
furniture_storage.description: Dedicated storage cabinets and enclosures for laboratory equipment, chemicals, and sensitive materials. Includes laboratory cabinets, base cabinets, overhead cabinets, flammable storage cabinets, acid storage cabinets, corrosive storage cabinets, under-counter cabinets, instrument cabinets, desiccator cabinets, and specialty storage enclosures for laboratory materials requiring controlled storage conditions.

furniture_storage.label: Chemical / Flammable Storage Cabinets
furniture_storage.description: Fixed cabinets and storage infrastructure for the safe storage of hazardous or flammable chemicals. Includes flammable liquid storage cabinets, corrosive storage cabinets, acid cabinets, and other fire-rated chemical storage infrastructure.

general_office_supplies.label: General Office Supplies
general_office_supplies.description: Non-laboratory office and administrative supplies used in scientific and research workplaces. Includes paper, notebooks, lab notebooks, pens, pencils, markers for writing (not lab labeling), writing instruments, binders, folders, staplers, tape, adhesives, printer supplies, toner cartridges, printer paper, computer accessories, desk accessories, and general administrative and stationery items. Does NOT include laboratory-specific PPE such as nitrile gloves, latex gloves, examination gloves, lab coats, safety goggles, or face shields — see Lab Supplies and Consumables. Does NOT include laboratory-specific cleaning supplies, sterilization wipes, or germicidal wipes — see Lab Supplies and Consumables.

histology_pathology.label: IHC (Immunohistochemistry)
histology_pathology.description: Antibody-based staining services to detect and localize specific protein targets in tissue sections. Includes chromogenic and fluorescent IHC, single- and multiplex-marker panels, and antibody optimization/titration on customer-supplied tissue.

histology_pathology.label: Special / Histochemical Stains
histology_pathology.description: Non-immunohistochemical staining services for visualizing tissue morphology and specific structures or substances. Includes H&E, Masson's trichrome, PAS, Alcian blue, Gomori's, and other special/histochemical stains.

histology_pathology.label: In Situ Hybridization (ISH)
histology_pathology.description: Services for detecting and localizing specific nucleic acid sequences (DNA/RNA) directly in tissue sections. Includes chromogenic and fluorescent ISH (FISH), RNAscope and other RNA ISH platforms, and multiplex ISH panels.

histology_pathology.label: Digital Pathology & Image Analysis
histology_pathology.description: Whole-slide scanning, image management, and quantitative image analysis services for stained tissue sections. Includes whole-slide imaging, automated scoring (e.g., H-score, percent positivity), and AI/ML-assisted image analysis.

histology_pathology.label: Electron Microscopy (TEM/SEM)
histology_pathology.description: Ultrastructural imaging services using transmission or scanning electron microscopy on tissue or cell specimens. Includes sample fixation and processing for EM, TEM imaging, SEM imaging, and immuno-EM.

histology_pathology.label: Tissue Processing & Sectioning
histology_pathology.description: Services for embedding, sectioning, and mounting tissue specimens in preparation for staining or molecular analysis. Includes paraffin and frozen tissue processing, microtomy/cryosectioning, and tissue microarray (TMA) construction.

histology_pathology.label: Necropsy & Toxicologic Pathology
histology_pathology.description: Gross and microscopic pathology assessment services performed on animal subjects, typically in support of toxicology studies. Includes necropsy, organ weight and gross lesion assessment, and board-certified toxicologic pathologist evaluation.

histology_pathology.label: Pathology Peer Review
histology_pathology.description: Independent secondary review of pathology findings and diagnoses by a qualified pathologist. Includes peer review of toxicologic pathology findings and quality control/consensus review for regulatory studies.

toxicology_safety_assessment.label: GLP Toxicology
toxicology_safety_assessment.description: Good Laboratory Practice-compliant nonclinical toxicology studies characterizing dose-related adverse effects of a test article. Includes single- and repeat-dose toxicity studies, dose range-finding studies, and regulatory (ICH/OECD-guideline) toxicology studies.

toxicology_safety_assessment.label: Safety Pharmacology
toxicology_safety_assessment.description: Studies assessing the potential adverse effects of a test article on vital organ systems. Includes cardiovascular (hERG, telemetry), respiratory, and central nervous system safety pharmacology studies, typically per ICH S7A/S7B guidelines.

toxicology_safety_assessment.label: Genetic Toxicology
toxicology_safety_assessment.description: Studies assessing the potential of a test article to cause genetic damage. Includes Ames/bacterial reverse mutation assay, in vitro micronucleus and chromosomal aberration assays, and in vivo genotoxicity studies.

toxicology_safety_assessment.label: Toxicokinetics
toxicology_safety_assessment.description: Pharmacokinetic assessment integrated into toxicology studies to characterize systemic exposure to a test article. Includes TK sampling and analysis conducted alongside GLP toxicology studies to support dose-exposure-response relationships.

toxicology_safety_assessment.label: Repeat-Dose / Chronic Studies
toxicology_safety_assessment.description: Extended-duration toxicology studies assessing cumulative and chronic effects of repeated test article administration. Includes subchronic and chronic (up to lifetime) repeat-dose toxicity studies in rodent and non-rodent species.

toxicology_safety_assessment.label: Specialty Toxicology
toxicology_safety_assessment.description: Specialized nonclinical safety studies outside routine general toxicology. Includes reproductive and developmental toxicology (DART), immunotoxicology, carcinogenicity studies, and juvenile toxicology studies.

dmpk_adme.label: In Vitro ADME
dmpk_adme.description: Cell- and enzyme-based assays characterizing a compound's absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion properties in vitro. Includes metabolic stability (microsomes, hepatocytes), CYP inhibition/induction screening, and plasma stability assays.

dmpk_adme.label: In Vivo PK / TK
dmpk_adme.description: Pharmacokinetic and toxicokinetic studies characterizing systemic drug exposure over time in a living animal model. Includes single- and multiple-dose PK studies, bioavailability studies, and cassette/cocktail dosing studies.

dmpk_adme.label: Metabolite Identification
dmpk_adme.description: Services identifying and characterizing the metabolites of a drug candidate. Includes in vitro and in vivo metabolite profiling, structure elucidation (LC-MS/MS, NMR), and reactive metabolite screening.

dmpk_adme.label: Drug-Drug Interaction
dmpk_adme.description: Studies assessing the potential for a drug candidate to interact with co-administered drugs via metabolic or transporter-mediated mechanisms. Includes CYP and UGT enzyme inhibition/induction studies and transporter (P-gp, BCRP) interaction studies.

dmpk_adme.label: Protein Binding
dmpk_adme.description: Assays measuring the extent to which a drug candidate binds to plasma or tissue proteins. Includes equilibrium dialysis, ultrafiltration, and ultracentrifugation-based plasma protein binding assays.

dmpk_adme.label: Permeability & Transporter
dmpk_adme.description: Assays characterizing a compound's membrane permeability and interaction with drug transporters. Includes Caco-2, MDCK, and PAMPA permeability assays, and transporter substrate/inhibition studies (P-gp, BCRP, OATP).

bioanalysis.label: Small-Molecule PK Bioanalysis
bioanalysis.description: Quantitative LC-MS/MS bioanalysis of small-molecule drugs and metabolites in biological matrices to support PK/TK studies. Includes GLP and non-GLP bioanalytical support for preclinical and clinical PK sample analysis.

bioanalysis.label: Large-Molecule Bioanalysis
bioanalysis.description: Quantitative bioanalysis of biologics (antibodies, proteins, peptides) in biological matrices, typically via ligand-binding or hybrid LC-MS assays. Includes PK bioanalysis of monoclonal antibodies, fusion proteins, and other biotherapeutics.

bioanalysis.label: Immunogenicity / ADA
bioanalysis.description: Assays detecting and characterizing anti-drug antibodies (ADA) and neutralizing antibodies generated in response to a biotherapeutic. Includes screening, confirmatory, and titer/neutralizing antibody assays per regulatory tiered testing strategies.

bioanalysis.label: Biomarker Assays
bioanalysis.description: Quantitative assays measuring pharmacodynamic or disease-related biomarkers in biological samples to support clinical or nonclinical studies. Includes ligand-binding assays, multiplex biomarker panels, and biomarker assay qualification.

bioanalysis.label: Method Development & Validation
bioanalysis.description: Development and regulatory validation of bioanalytical methods for a specific analyte and matrix. Includes fit-for-purpose and GLP/regulated (FDA/EMA) bioanalytical method validation.

cmc_analytical_qc.label: Method Development & Validation
cmc_analytical_qc.description: Development and validation of analytical methods used to characterize and release drug substance and drug product. Includes HPLC/UPLC, GC, and compendial method development and ICH Q2-compliant validation.

cmc_analytical_qc.label: Stability Studies
cmc_analytical_qc.description: GMP stability testing programs assessing drug substance/product quality over time under defined storage conditions. Includes ICH-condition stability studies, forced degradation studies, and photostability testing.

cmc_analytical_qc.label: Release Testing
cmc_analytical_qc.description: GMP analytical testing performed to release a drug substance or drug product batch against its specification. Includes identity, assay/potency, purity, and dissolution testing.

cmc_analytical_qc.label: Impurity / E&L Testing
cmc_analytical_qc.description: Analytical testing to identify and quantify impurities, degradants, and extractables/leachables. Includes related substances testing, elemental impurity (ICH Q3D) testing, and container-closure extractables/leachables studies.

cmc_analytical_qc.label: Microbiology / Sterility
cmc_analytical_qc.description: GMP microbiological testing services supporting drug product quality and safety. Includes sterility testing, bioburden testing, endotoxin (LAL) testing, and environmental monitoring.

cmc_analytical_qc.label: Raw Material Testing
cmc_analytical_qc.description: Incoming quality control testing of raw materials, excipients, and components used in drug manufacturing. Includes identity testing, compendial (USP/EP) raw material release testing, and vendor qualification testing.

clinical_trial_services_cro.label: Trial Management & Monitoring
clinical_trial_services_cro.description: Operational oversight services for clinical trial conduct, including on-site and remote monitoring visits. Includes project/trial management, clinical monitoring (CRA) visits, and risk-based monitoring services.

clinical_trial_services_cro.label: Site Management
clinical_trial_services_cro.description: Services supporting the selection, activation, and ongoing management of clinical trial sites. Includes site feasibility and selection, site activation, and site-facing CRO/SMO services.

clinical_trial_services_cro.label: Patient Recruitment & Retention
clinical_trial_services_cro.description: Services supporting identification, enrollment, and retention of clinical trial participants. Includes patient recruitment campaigns, pre-screening, and retention/engagement programs.

clinical_trial_services_cro.label: Clinical Data Management
clinical_trial_services_cro.description: Services for collecting, cleaning, and managing clinical trial data. Includes EDC (electronic data capture) setup and management, data cleaning/query resolution, and database lock support.

clinical_trial_services_cro.label: Biostatistics
clinical_trial_services_cro.description: Statistical design, analysis, and reporting services for clinical trials. Includes statistical analysis plan (SAP) development, randomization, and statistical analysis/reporting of trial results.

clinical_trial_services_cro.label: Medical Writing
clinical_trial_services_cro.description: Preparation of clinical and regulatory documents supporting trial conduct and reporting. Includes protocol writing, clinical study report (CSR) writing, and informed consent form development.

clinical_trial_services_cro.label: Clinical Supply & Logistics
clinical_trial_services_cro.description: Services for the packaging, labeling, distribution, and management of investigational product supply for clinical trials. Includes clinical packaging/labeling, IRT/IVRS-managed supply forecasting, and comparator sourcing.

central_lab_services.label: Routine Safety Labs
central_lab_services.description: Standard clinical laboratory testing (chemistry, hematology, urinalysis) performed for routine safety monitoring in clinical trials. Includes serum chemistry panels, complete blood count (CBC), and coagulation testing.

central_lab_services.label: Specialty / Esoteric Testing
central_lab_services.description: Non-routine, specialized laboratory testing requiring specific expertise or platforms. Includes esoteric/reference lab testing, specialized assay panels, and low-volume/rare-analyte testing.

central_lab_services.label: Biomarker Testing
central_lab_services.description: Central-lab testing of pharmacodynamic, safety, or efficacy biomarkers across multi-site clinical trials. Includes standardized biomarker panels and cross-site biomarker testing harmonization.

central_lab_services.label: Flow Cytometry
central_lab_services.description: Central-lab flow cytometry testing services for immunophenotyping and cell-based endpoints in clinical trials. Includes standardized immunophenotyping panels and multi-site flow cytometry harmonization.

central_lab_services.label: Kit Build & Logistics
central_lab_services.description: Assembly, labeling, and global distribution of sample-collection kits for clinical trial sites. Includes kit build, kit distribution/logistics, and site kit inventory management.

central_lab_services.label: Sample Management
central_lab_services.description: Tracking, storage, and shipment coordination for clinical trial biological samples across a study's lifecycle. Includes sample tracking/LIMS support, chain-of-custody management, and cold-chain shipment coordination.

biomarker_companion_diagnostics.label: Biomarker Assay Development
biomarker_companion_diagnostics.description: Development of novel or fit-for-purpose biomarker assays supporting drug development. Includes exploratory and analytically validated biomarker assay development for pharmacodynamic, safety, or patient-selection biomarkers.

biomarker_companion_diagnostics.label: Companion Diagnostic (CDx) Development
biomarker_companion_diagnostics.description: Development of in vitro diagnostic tests co-developed with a therapeutic to identify patients likely to benefit from treatment. Includes CDx assay development, analytical/clinical validation, and regulatory co-submission support.

biomarker_companion_diagnostics.label: Clinical Assay Validation
biomarker_companion_diagnostics.description: Validation of clinical laboratory assays to demonstrate analytical and clinical performance for use in a clinical trial or diagnostic context. Includes analytical validation (precision, accuracy, sensitivity/specificity) and clinical validation studies.

biomarker_companion_diagnostics.label: Genomic / Molecular Profiling
biomarker_companion_diagnostics.description: Genomic and molecular profiling services characterizing a sample's genetic, transcriptomic, or mutational profile. Includes next-generation sequencing (NGS) panels, gene expression profiling, and mutation/variant testing.

regulatory_affairs.label: Regulatory Strategy
regulatory_affairs.description: Consulting services developing a regulatory pathway and strategy for a drug or device candidate. Includes regulatory strategy consulting, health authority meeting preparation, and orphan/breakthrough designation strategy.

regulatory_affairs.label: Dossier / eCTD Preparation
regulatory_affairs.description: Preparation and compilation of regulatory submission dossiers in required formats. Includes eCTD compilation, module authoring/formatting, and submission publishing.

regulatory_affairs.label: Submissions & Agency Liaison
regulatory_affairs.description: Services managing the submission process and ongoing communication with regulatory health authorities. Includes IND/NDA/BLA/MAA submission management and health authority query response coordination.

regulatory_affairs.label: Labeling
regulatory_affairs.description: Development and maintenance of drug product labeling and prescribing information. Includes core data sheet (CDS) and package insert/label development and label harmonization across markets.

regulatory_affairs.label: Auditing & Compliance
regulatory_affairs.description: Quality assurance audits and regulatory compliance support services. Includes GxP audits (GLP/GCP/GMP), vendor qualification audits, and regulatory inspection readiness support.

pharmacovigilance_drug_safety.label: Case Processing
pharmacovigilance_drug_safety.description: Intake, triage, and processing of individual adverse event case reports. Includes individual case safety report (ICSR) intake, data entry, medical coding (MedDRA), and case narrative writing.

pharmacovigilance_drug_safety.label: Signal Detection
pharmacovigilance_drug_safety.description: Analysis of safety data to identify potential new safety signals for a marketed or investigational product. Includes statistical signal detection, disproportionality analysis, and signal evaluation/validation.

pharmacovigilance_drug_safety.label: Aggregate Reports
pharmacovigilance_drug_safety.description: Preparation of periodic aggregate safety reports required by health authorities. Includes PSUR, PBRER, and DSUR authoring and submission support.

pharmacovigilance_drug_safety.label: Literature Monitoring
pharmacovigilance_drug_safety.description: Ongoing surveillance of scientific literature for safety-relevant information about a product. Includes systematic literature searches and case identification from published literature.

pharmacovigilance_drug_safety.label: Risk Management
pharmacovigilance_drug_safety.description: Development and maintenance of risk management plans and risk minimization measures for a product. Includes REMS/RMP development, risk minimization materials, and effectiveness assessments.

heor_rwe_market_access.label: HEOR Modeling
heor_rwe_market_access.description: Health economic modeling services quantifying the clinical and economic value of a therapy. Includes cost-effectiveness modeling, budget impact modeling, and cost-of-illness studies.

heor_rwe_market_access.label: Real-World Evidence Studies
heor_rwe_market_access.description: Studies using real-world data sources to characterize disease burden, treatment patterns, or outcomes. Includes retrospective and prospective RWE studies using claims, EHR, or registry data.

heor_rwe_market_access.label: Systematic Literature Review
heor_rwe_market_access.description: Structured review and synthesis of published evidence to support HEOR, regulatory, or clinical claims. Includes systematic literature reviews, network meta-analyses, and evidence gap analyses.

heor_rwe_market_access.label: Payer / Value Dossiers
heor_rwe_market_access.description: Development of evidence dossiers to support payer and reimbursement decision-making. Includes global value dossiers (GVD) and AMCP-format dossier development.

heor_rwe_market_access.label: Pricing & Market Access
heor_rwe_market_access.description: Strategic consulting services supporting product pricing and reimbursement strategy. Includes pricing strategy, market access consulting, and reimbursement landscape assessment.

phase_iv_post_marketing_studies.label: Observational Studies
phase_iv_post_marketing_studies.description: Non-interventional studies characterizing product use or outcomes in real-world clinical practice. Includes prospective and retrospective observational cohort and case-control studies.

phase_iv_post_marketing_studies.label: Patient Registries
phase_iv_post_marketing_studies.description: Establishment and management of structured, longitudinal patient data collection programs. Includes disease registries and product/exposure registries for post-marketing surveillance.

phase_iv_post_marketing_studies.label: Late-Phase Trials
phase_iv_post_marketing_studies.description: Interventional clinical trials conducted after initial marketing approval. Includes Phase IIIb/IV interventional trials and pragmatic trial designs.

phase_iv_post_marketing_studies.label: Post-Auth Safety Studies (PASS)
phase_iv_post_marketing_studies.description: Studies required or requested by health authorities to further characterize a product's safety profile post-approval. Includes PASS protocol development, execution, and regulatory reporting.

medical_affairs_medical_communications.label: Medical Writing & Publications
medical_affairs_medical_communications.description: Preparation of scientific manuscripts, abstracts, and posters communicating clinical or research findings. Includes manuscript writing, abstract/poster development, and publication planning.

medical_affairs_medical_communications.label: Medical Communications
medical_affairs_medical_communications.description: Development of scientific and educational content and materials for healthcare professional or scientific audiences. Includes slide decks, scientific platforms, and medical education content.

medical_affairs_medical_communications.label: MSL Support
medical_affairs_medical_communications.description: Field-based medical science liaison services engaging with healthcare providers and key opinion leaders on scientific/clinical topics. Includes MSL staffing, training, and field medical support.

medical_affairs_medical_communications.label: Scientific Advisory / KOL
medical_affairs_medical_communications.description: Coordination and execution of scientific advisory boards and key opinion leader engagement activities. Includes advisory board planning/execution and KOL identification and engagement.
